title: Final Internal Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The total change in internal energy must be correctly identified as zero.

title: Total Work Done
description: Essential Criteria: The total work done by the nitrogen must be calculated correctly as 17.4 kJ.

title: Total Heat Supplied
description: Essential Criteria: The total heat supplied must be correctly identified as equal to the work done, 17.4 kJ.

title: Final Volume
description: Essential Criteria: The final volume must be correctly calculated as 0.226 m^3.

title: Entropy Change Cars
description: Important Criteria: The change in entropy for the cars must be calculated correctly as 2.02 kJ/K.

title: Entropy Change System
description: Important Criteria: The total change in entropy for the insulated Al cup and water must be calculated correctly as 2.24 J/K.

title: P-V Diagram
description: Optional Criteria: A correct P-V diagram illustrating the process must be provided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common unit mistakes, such as failing to convert temperatures to Kelvin or using incorrect units for energy, must be avoided.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in calculations, particularly in work and heat, must be avoided.
